notes: הֲ and לֹא each stand once at the head of the first of two coordinated questions and are rewritten by the ASV over the second, so each takes both of its English occurrences in one discontinuous unit headed on the first — rule 25's own הֲלוֹא מַחֲזֵה־שָׁוְא example.
רֹאשׁ takes the distributive *every* it licenses, גֶּבֶר keeping its own *man* (rule 15); leaving רֹאשׁ unrepresented was the alternative.
The duals רַחֲמָתַיִם and רִקְמָתַיִם each take their whole multi-word rendering, headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 31).
